name: cyberine-devguard
description: Keeps a Claude Code session inside its own repository: a zero-dependency PreToolUse hook that asks before Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, an obvious Bash write or a filesystem MCP write touches another git repository that the session was not given, before a Bash git worktree add lands outside .claude/worktrees/, and denies data-destroying Bash commands (recursive rm outside temp and build folders, git reset --hard, force-push to a protected branch, terraform destroy, DROP TABLE and similar) in every permission mode, plus status, explain and worktree report skills.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: One of ask, deny-once, warn, off. ask: ask before a write outside the session's scope (default). deny-once: deny the first such write per session and repository, allow a retry for 10 minutes. warn: never block, show a notice. off: do nothing. Any other value falls back to ask with a warning.

extra_allowed_dirs.title: Extra allowed directories
extra_allowed_dirs.description: Absolute directories every session may write to without a prompt, in addition to the session repository and its allowed directories.

hub_repos.title: Hub repositories
hub_repos.description: Absolute paths of repositories whose own submodules count as part of the repository, so a session there may write into them.

allow_ignored.title: Allow gitignored targets
allow_ignored.description: Let a session write to a path that the other repository ignores, such as its .local/ or build output.

allow_ignored_nested_repos.title: Allow repositories nested in ignored paths
allow_ignored_nested_repos.description: Let a session write into a git repository that sits inside its own repository under a path the session repository gitignores, such as an agent's scratch repository in .local/tmp/. Turn it off to be asked about those writes like any other repository.

log_decisions.title: Log decisions
log_decisions.description: Append each cross-repository verdict (time, session id, tool, path, verdict) to decisions.jsonl in the plugin data directory. Nothing is sent anywhere.

read_transcript.title: Read allowed directories from the transcript
read_transcript.description: Read the environment snapshot that Claude Code writes into the session transcript, which also reflects directories removed during the session, and allow the directory a /cd moved the session to. Off by default: Cyberine DevGuard then takes allowed directories from settings, /add-dir and --add-dir, and never opens the transcript.

worktree_guard.title: Guard git worktree add
worktree_guard.description: Ask before a Bash command runs git worktree add for a path outside the repository's .claude/worktrees/ (for example a /tmp folder). Best effort: it reads the command text, so a script or a variable can hide the path.

isolate_worktrees.title: Isolate worktrees
isolate_worktrees.description: Ask before a session started in a linked git worktree writes with Write, Edit or NotebookEdit into the main checkout or another worktree of the same repository. Off by default, because many workflows write from a worktree back to the main checkout on purpose.

bash_guard.title: Guard obvious Bash writes
bash_guard.description: Read each Bash command for obvious write shapes (> and >> redirects, tee, sed -i, cp, mv, install, ln, rsync, touch, mkdir, rm, rmdir, truncate, dd of=, and git commands that change a repository) and treat each target like a file-tool write. Best effort: a script, an alias, a variable or eval can hide a write.

danger_guard.title: Deny data-destroying Bash commands
danger_guard.description: Deny, in every permission mode including bypassPermissions, Bash commands that destroy data or rewrite shared history: recursive rm outside temp, worktree and build folders, git reset --hard, git checkout -- ., git restore ., git clean -f, a force-push to a protected branch or with no branch named, terraform destroy, kubectl delete of a namespace, volume or --all, docker system prune, docker volume rm/prune, docker compose down -v, DROP DATABASE/SCHEMA/TABLE and TRUNCATE. Also inside ssh, bash -c and other wrappers. Start a session with CY_ALLOW_DANGER=1 to lift it for that session.

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Branch names a force-push to is denied while danger_guard is on.

deny_aws_s3_deletes.title: Deny aws s3 deletes
deny_aws_s3_deletes.description: While danger_guard is on, also deny aws s3 rm, aws s3 rb and aws s3api delete-bucket/delete-object/delete-objects.

bypass_strict.title: Strict under bypassPermissions
bypass_strict.description: Under bypassPermissions, deny every write to another repository. Off by default: the first write per session and repository is denied with a note telling Claude to retry only if you asked for that target, and a retry within 10 minutes passes, so you can still ask for a cross-repository change in chat.

allow_danger_env.title: Extra escape variable
allow_danger_env.description: Name of a second environment variable that, set to 1 when the session starts, lifts danger_guard for that session, in addition to CY_ALLOW_DANGER. A value set by a repository's .claude settings env block is ignored.
